items.text: A developer stages the named household landing and manifesto prerequisites without unrelated writes, then measures the complete household failover feature against the current runtime

A beacon contributes only its own shared DNS records while its doorway serves, withdraws after three consecutive non-serving probes, and rejoins after two consecutive serving probes without changing exclusive diagnostic names or siblings

An apex-transition story distinguishes shared address membership from actual host-to-doorway selection, and its final assertion cannot pass without observing a shed, sibling delivery of the declared head, and recovery
A new agent can recover each station's current source, admitted run evidence, predecessor limits and remaining frontier using native flow context and ledger queries
A visitor opening the same packaged app through either household doorway reads real content through that serving doorway, without a rebuild or requests to the compiled production host

An anonymous reader already using a household doorway follows a related public atom during that doorway's outage, reads it through a discovered sibling, and returns to the recovered original doorway on a bounded read probe

After one steward cancels a project-epr commitment on one household peer, every peer resolves that updated commitment from its own conductor and withdraws the projected route without a second cancellation or reseed
A visitor receives a browser shell and its referenced assets from the same declared bundle through each doorway, including while a storage peer retains an older slug mapping
